source.prompt: Flat orthographic straight-on photograph of exactly 2 m x 2 m of an interior plaster wall, face-on, filling the entire frame edge to edge. Old pale green paint peeling and flaking in irregular patches revealing grey plaster beneath. Muted desaturated Soviet industrial ruin, physically plausible colours. Even overcast diffuse daylight, no cast shadows, no directional light, no vignette, no lighting gradient, no perspective, no objects, no text, no watermark. Uniform exposure across the whole image. The old paint is a dull, desaturated grey-green (sage, low saturation, slightly dirty and faded), not minty or bright.
